summary: Lely is agricultural machine manufacturer, founded in 1948. About 2,300 employees (Wikidata). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 4 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

insights.one_liner: Maassluis maker of dairy farm robots and data systems since 1948; IND recognised sponsor whose tech jobs don't need Dutch and often show pay.

culture.text: Develops robots and data systems for dairy farms that aim to improve animal welfare and farm productivity.
All 4 open jobs here are in Maassluis, in software and data, and 3 of 4 show pay.

open.text: Lely International N.V., Lely Nederland N.V. and Lely Services B.V. are IND recognised visa sponsors.
All 4 open jobs here don't ask for Dutch, but LinkedIn postings average about 200 applicants.

growth.text: Launched a new generation robotic milker, the Lely Astronaut A5 Next.

worth_knowing.text: Won a Dutch Design Award in the Product category.
